# GetHotelStays (gethotelstays.com)

> India's premier online hotel booking and micro-stay platform with 10,000+ verified properties. Book hotels across Delhi, Goa, Jaipur, Mumbai, Manali, and 50+ Indian cities by paying only 12% online and the rest directly at the hotel.

## Key Value Propositions
- **Pay 12% Now Model**: Pay just 12% deposit online to confirm reservation; settle remaining 88% at check-in.
- **Hourly & Micro-Stays**: Flexible 3-hour, 6-hour, and 12-hour hotel bookings for layovers, transit, and day use.
- **Couple-Friendly & 100% Privacy**: Pre-screened hotels welcoming local IDs and unmarried couples without awkward questions.
- **NRI & International Booking**: Seamless support for overseas travelers from USA, UK, UAE, Canada, Australia with international cards & PayPal.
- **ChatGHS AI Travel Concierge**: Integrated AI travel planner and booking assistant at https://ai.gethotelstays.com
